content.short: Chainbase provides Web3 data infrastructure for indexing and using on-chain data at scale.
content.description: Chainbase is a Web3 data infrastructure that lets you index, transform, and query on-chain data at scale through APIs, data pipelines, and SQL. It leverages enriched on-chain data and streaming compute across the data stack to automate the indexing and querying of blockchain data. This unified approach reduces the manual effort required to prepare data, accelerates development workflows, and helps developers build more capable applications with less overhead and complexity.
